test_title: PYST 37: SSC MTS - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: What will be the compound interest (in ₹) on ₹ 10,000 for 2 years at 5% per annum, compounded annually?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs. 10,000

Rate = 5%

Time = 2 years

**Formula used:**

A = P(1 + R/100)T

CI = A – P

**Calculation:**

According to the question

A = P(1 + R/100)T

⇒ A = 10,000 × (1 + 5/100)²

⇒ 10,000 × (105/100)²

⇒ (10,000 × 21/20 × 21/20)

⇒ (25 × 21 × 21)

⇒ Rs.11,025

Now,

CI = A – P

⇒ CI = Rs. (11,025 – 10,000)

⇒ Rs. 1025

**∴ The required CI is Rs. 1025**
